title: StratoBlob - Silly memory racing game
author: Paran0a
selftext:
# [StratoBlob](https://stratoblob.com/)

Not much to say , you can play solo or with friends ( and bots if you want to ).

Something fun and simple to wake up your brain in the morning.

\---

Tell me if the music is annoying or sound effects need work ( im sure they do I suck here ), and what  you dislike about the game.

  
I already did a 180 once, but I kept working on it cause I like the aesthetics so much.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Paran0a could you add more about how AI fit into your development process? Just mentioning that AI was used doesn't cut it. Under Rule 4, promotional posts need to contribute something by discussing how the game was actually made. Otherwise the sub gets buried in ads. If there's no update, this post may be removed.

replies.author: Paran0a
replies.body:
Of course , everything was developed by AI. Theres really nothing fancy here, ThreeJS , no assets, simple gameplay ( I suppose the gameplay was the original thing , dictated by me, which is the reason why im asking for feedback ). Music by Suno. Probably would take me month+ to develop this by hand , while with Claude it was less than 24h.  
The style and feel of the game was the longest thing it took to develop as the initial prototype was rather bland.
